title: v1.2 replacement for state-14: Empty accounts list includes both providers
notes: With no saved login, provider list prints the ChatGPT and Grok rows even when accounts.yaml has an empty ChatGPT map (§1.7.6, §2.7, §4.10).

rows.label: empty map
rows.doc:
# Kogen accounts on this machine, written by kogen provider use.
chatgpt: {}

rows.label: rows
rows.doc:
# Kogen accounts on this machine, written by kogen provider use.
chatgpt:
  default: work
  projects:
    - path: "{checkout}"
      account: work

expect.stdout:
chatgpt: not signed in
grok: not signed in

expect.stdout_regex:
\A(environment/invalid_accounts_file: {home}/\.kogen/accounts\.yaml is not valid; fix or delete it|provider/login: chatgpt:work has no saved login; run kogen provider login chatgpt --as work)
\Z
